cases.learning_focus: Explain cell-volume changes across a membrane
cases.prerequisite_knowledge: Knows cells have membranes; no lab experience.
expected_learning_outcomes: Predict water movement with an impermeable solute.
Explain effects on an animal cell.
Distinguish dynamic equilibrium from stopped movement.
cases.additional_constraints: Target level: Upper secondary biology. Use supplied hypothetical scenarios; do not require personal project experience.
cases.source_kind: synthetic candidate, not authoritative gold standard
expected_objective_coverage: Predict water movement with an impermeable solute.
Explain effects on an animal cell.
Distinguish dynamic equilibrium from stopped movement.
important_factual_concepts: Water moves toward higher nonpenetrating-solute concentration in the stated model.
Dynamic equilibrium retains molecular motion.
Tonicity depends on membrane permeability.
misconceptions: animal and plant cells behave identically

expected_objective_coverage: Relate net force to acceleration for constant mass.
Explain motion when net force is zero.
